environment.description: EKS pod in namespace 'platform-services' behind an internal-facing AWS NLB (scheme: internal) with target group health checks on /healthz. The NLB's associated security group references a prefix list (pl-0a8f2e19c7d4b3601) that resolves to three /28 CIDR blocks allocated to the corporate VPN egress NAT pool and the Datadog synthetic monitoring source IPs. The prefix list is managed by a CloudFormation stack with drift detection enabled (stack: 'network-allowlist-prod') and the security group has no additional ingress rules. VPC flow logs confirm only traffic from these CIDRs reaches the NLB ENIs. The pod itself has a Kubernetes NetworkPolicy (policy: 'deny-external-except-nlb') that restricts ingress to the NLB's subnet CIDR (10.0.48.0/20) on port 8080 only.

config.security_group_ingress: prefix-list pl-0a8f2e19c7d4b3601 (corporate VPN NAT /28s + Datadog synthetics)
config.vpc_flow_logs: enabled, confirming only prefix-list CIDRs reach NLB
